messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-331234: canary embed-service (release-v2026.03.13) reporting high 5xx rate and p95 tokenization latency spike. Links: https://ops.redwood/incidents/INC-331234 ; PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood/INC-331234

katie: acked the page. I'm oncall for the hour, looking at canary pods now. @sam can you grab pod logs and rollout status?

sam: ack. running quick checks now.

sam: ```bash
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embed-service-canary
NAME                                       READY  STATUS   RESTARTS   AGE
embed-service-canary-78f5d6b6c-7g2qf       1/1    Running  0          8m
embed-service-canary-78f5d6b6c-9k3rt       0/1    CrashLoopBackOff  4  7m
```

sam: grabbing logs from the crashing pod now.```

sam: ```
2026-03-13T21:14:02Z ERROR tokenizer: segmentation fault in quantize_pass()
    at /app/vendor/tokenizer/quant.c:412
    stack: tokenizer::quantize->model::load_kv->runtime::init_kernels
```

pagerduty: PagerDuty notice - Incident INC-331234 acknowledged by katie (oncall). Escalation paused.

leo: I'm joining. Looking at traffic split - canary got 5% traffic via traffic-router policy. If canary failing, we should stop routing and rollback to previous canary image. Any sign of config drift?

olivia: customer-impact: metrics show ~12% of generate/embed calls get 5xx from us-west-2 over the past 8m. Affected keys mostly internal and a couple enterprise previews (IDs obfuscated). No billing impact alerts but customer latency dashboards show tokenization errors.

katie: good catch. sam, if logs indicate a tokenizer segfault after the quant build, that sounds like a build-time kernel incompatibility. Plan: pause traffic to canary, rollback canary deployment to previous stable image, and open a quick regression issue.

sam: running pause traffic script and rollback now. commands:
```bash
# pause canary traffic
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/traffic-split -d '{"service":"embed-service","canary":0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
# rollback canary
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embed-service-canary --to-revision=41
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/embed-service-canary --timeout=3m
```

sam: pause api returned 200. starting rollback. rollout status: "deployment \"embed-service-canary\" successfully rolled out"

katie: seeing pods come up healthy. p95 latency trending back toward baseline on the canary metric (now 160ms down from 920ms peak). copying quick metric snapshot: 
- pre-rollback p95 embed: 920ms 
- 2m after rollback: 180ms 
- error rate: from 12% -> 1.4% and trending down

incident-bot: Auto-mitigation note: traffic-router applied fallback policy -> route away from canary to stable cluster. Autoscaler left unchanged.

leo: thanks. I'm going to hold the release gate for v2026.03.13. Please do not promote until eng-ml confirms quant build test matrix.

olivia: I'll notify the small set of affected customers with a short note: "We detected an issue with a canary release causing elevated errors; rollback applied and service restored. We'll follow up with postmortem."

katie: filing incident ticket and starting a short postmortem draft. Next steps for follow-up: (1) eng-ml to run quantization kernel compatibility suite against target CUDA / cuDNN images, (2) add canary healthcheck to include tokenization smoke test, (3) improve rollout automation to auto-pause on segmentation faults. Assigning owners: sam -> rollback verification + logs upload, leo -> release gate, olivia -> customer comms, eng-ml -> root-cause.

pagerduty: PagerDuty - Incident INC-331234 status updated: Mitigated (reversion applied). Please update incident timeline and mark as resolved when postmortem is filed.

katie: marking incident as mitigated. I'll leave PD incident open until postmortem is submitted (EOD). Good job team. :thumbsup:

sam: uploading relevant logs and the failing image digest to the incident ticket now.

leo: adding an action item to the release checklist: run tokenization smoke in staging + prod-like quant kernels before canary promotion.

katie: last check - any remaining 5xx spikes?

olivia: current graph flatlining, no new spikes for 6m, error rate back to baseline.

katie: closing pager. Will follow up with a short postmortem and RCA. Thanks all."
